blocks.text: Bea Milan-Windorski is always proud to represent the Philippines and bring a piece of home to every event at the 2026 Miss Universe pageant in Puerto Rico. At the “Luz de Esperanza: Universo Rosa en Puerto Rico” (Light of Hope: Pink Universe in Puerto Rico), a breast cancer awareness initiative, Windorski joined other candidates at the Aloft Ponce in the United States territory in wearing shades of pink.
